svg.title: Dragon's Egg plant portrait
svg.desc: Photo-informed schematic of Dragon's Egg as a round grey-green body with closely spaced raised ribs and small pale tan dots, in mixed mineral top dressing and a yellow faceted pot. The probable hybrid identification remains qualified in the plant profile.
